description:
As a Field Service Coordinator
  I want to open Job Risk Assessments from the App Launcher and search the list
  So that I can quickly check which jobs already have a risk assessment

elements.name: SC-01.01 Open Job Risk Assessments from the App Launcher and see the Recently Viewed list

steps.name: I am logged into Salesforce as a sales agent
I open Job Risk Assessments from the App Launcher
the "Recently Viewed" list view of Job Risk Assessments is displayed
the "Recently Viewed" list shows the "Job Risk Assesment Name" column and an item count
the list view offers the buttons "New", "Import", "Change Owner" and "Assign Label"

elements.name: SC-01.02 Search the list for a created assessment and open its record page

steps.name: I am logged into Salesforce as a sales agent
I have created a Job Risk Assessment from "assessmentA"
I search the "Recently Viewed" list for the created assessment
only the created assessment is listed
I open the created assessment from the list
the record page of the created assessment is displayed

name: US-01 Find and Browse Job Risk Assessments

description:
As a Field Service Coordinator
  I want to open a Job Risk Assessment and see all its details on one page
  So that I can review the assessment before the job starts

elements.name: SC-03.01 Record page header and Details tab show all fields with the record's values

steps.name: I am logged into Salesforce as a sales agent
I have created a Job Risk Assessment from "assessmentA"
the record page header shows "Job Risk Assessment" and the created assessment name
the Details tab shows the fields of "detailsLayout"
the Details tab shows the values of "assessmentA"
the Owner, Created By and Last Modified By show the current user

elements.name: SC-03.02 Record page offers the actions, the Related tab and the Activity panel

I have created a Job Risk Assessment from "assessmentA"
the record page offers the actions "Generate Assessment", "New Contact" and "New Opportunity"

name: US-03 View Job Risk Assessment Details

description:
As a Field Service Coordinator
  I want to create a Job Risk Assessment with the job details and the assessed risk
  So that every job has a recorded health and safety assessment before work starts

elements.name: SC-02.01 Create a Job Risk Assessment with all fields and verify the saved record

steps.name: I am logged into Salesforce as a sales agent
I am on the Job Risk Assessments list view
I open the New Job Risk Assessment form
the New Job Risk Assessment form shows the "Information" section with the Owner pre-filled
I fill the form with "assessmentA" and click "Save"
the success message for the created assessment is shown
the record page of the created assessment is displayed
the Details tab shows the values of "assessmentA"

elements.name: SC-02.02 Create a Job Risk Assessment with the alternative values and verify the saved record

steps.name: I am logged into Salesforce as a sales agent
I have created a Job Risk Assessment from "assessmentB"
the success message for the created assessment is shown
the Details tab shows the values of "assessmentB"

elements.name: SC-02.03 New form shows all fields, the picklist values and the Owner pre-filled

steps.name: I am logged into Salesforce as a sales agent
I am on the Job Risk Assessments list view
I open the New Job Risk Assessment form
the New Job Risk Assessment form shows the "Information" section with the Owner pre-filled
the form shows the fields of "formLayout"
the picklists offer the values of "formLayout"
I cancel the New Job Risk Assessment form
the New Job Risk Assessment form is closed

elements.name: SC-02.04 Save & New creates the record and opens a new, empty form

steps.name: I am logged into Salesforce as a sales agent
I am on the Job Risk Assessments list view
I open the New Job Risk Assessment form
I fill the form with "assessmentA" and click "Save & New"
the success message for the created assessment is shown
an empty New Job Risk Assessment form is displayed
I cancel the New Job Risk Assessment form
I search the "All" list for the created assessment
only the created assessment is listed

elements.name: SC-02.05 Cancel closes the New form without creating a record

steps.name: I am logged into Salesforce as a sales agent
I am on the Job Risk Assessments list view
I open the New Job Risk Assessment form
I fill the form with "assessmentCancel" without saving
I cancel the New Job Risk Assessment form
the New Job Risk Assessment form is closed without a success message
I search the "All" list for the cancelled assessment
the list shows "0 items" and the message "Nothing to see here"

elements.name: SC-02.06 Saving an empty New form is blocked with an error and creates no record

steps.name: I am logged into Salesforce as a sales agent
I am on the Job Risk Assessments list view
I open the New Job Risk Assessment form
I save the New Job Risk Assessment form without entering any values
saving is blocked with an error and no Job Risk Assessment is created

description:
As a Field Service Coordinator
  I want to generate a Job Risk Assessment PDF from the record
  So that I can share a formal Health & Safety Assessment Report with the technician and the client

elements.name: SC-04.01 Generate Assessment produces a PDF report for the record

steps.name: I am logged into Salesforce as a sales agent
I have created a Job Risk Assessment from "assessmentA"
I generate the assessment report
a PDF document is produced for the created assessment

name: US-04 Generate the Job Risk Assessment PDF Report
